A [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''member''' of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], a [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble house]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and served as [[Lord/Legends|lord]] of their house sometime well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The lord had at least three younger brothers, and when their [[Nomar Organa's father|third brother's]] son [[Nomar Organa|Nomar]] exhibited [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] at a young age, the lord gave their nephew to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a gift.<ref name="Nomar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nomar Organa's uncle was mentioned in Nomar Organa's entry in the Codex for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Nomar" />
